---
title: "FFA Report"
output:
  html_document:
    css: styles.css
params: 
    selection_metric: "[selection_metric]"
    selection_results: "[selection_results]"
    estimation_method: "[estimation_method]"
    estimation_results: "[estimation_results]"
    uncertainty_method: "[uncertainty_method]"
    uncertainty_results: "[uncertainty_results]"
    assessment: "[assessment]"
    output_dir: "[output_dir]"
---

## '`r selection_metric`' Distribution Selection

**Recommended Distribution**: `r selection_results$recommendation`

<!-- Model Selection Table -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
distance <- selection_results$distance
metrics <- sapply(distance, function(x) round(x$metric, 4))

df <- data.frame(
	Distribution = names(distance),
	Metric = unname(metrics)
)

knitr::kable(df, align = "cc")
```

<!-- Model Selection Plot -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
img_name <- glue("img/{ tolower(selection_metric) }-selection.png")
include_graphics(file.path(params$output_dir, img_name))
```

## '`r estimation_method`' Parameter Estimation

<!-- Parameter Estimation Table -->
**Estimated Parameters**: `r round(estimation_results, 4)`

## '`r uncertainty_method`' Uncertainty Quantification

<!-- Uncertainty Quantification Table -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
columns <- c("Estimates", "CI (Lower)", "CI (Upper)", "Years")
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(uncertainty_results), col.names = columns, align = "cccc")
```

<!-- Uncertainty Quantification Plot -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
img_name <- glue("img/{ tolower(uncertainty_method) }-results.png")
include_graphics(file.path(params$output_dir, img_name))
```

## Model Assessment

<!-- Model Assessment Table -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
assessment_df <- data.frame(
	R2 = round(assessment$R2, 4),
	RMSE = round(assessment$RMSE, 4),
	Bias = round(assessment$Bias, 4),
	AIC = round(assessment$AIC, 4), 
	BIC = round(assessment$BIC, 4), 
	AW = round(assessment$AW, 4), 
	POC = round(assessment$POC, 4),
	CWI = round(assessment$CWI, 4)
)

knitr::kable(assessment_df, align = "cccccccc")
```

<!-- Model Selection Plot -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
include_graphics(file.path(params$output_dir, "img/assessment-results.png"))
```
